mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.source_ticket_id, a.status, a.author_id, a.view_count, a.published_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_by, a.update_by, a.deleted, c.name AS category_name, u.username AS author_name, t.ticket_no AS source_ticket_no, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT kt.name ORDER BY kt.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tag_names
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_article a LEFT JOIN knowledge_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.source_ticket_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_article_tag kat ON kat.article_id = a.id AND kat.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_tag kt ON kt.id = kat.tag_id AND kt.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.source_ticket_id, a.status, a.author_id, a.view_count, a.published_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_by, a.update_by, a.deleted, c.name, u.username, t.ticket_no LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM knowledge_article a LEFT JOIN knowledge_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.source_ticket_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_article_tag kat ON kat.article_id = a.id AND kat.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN knowledge_tag kt ON kt.id = kat.tag_id AND kt.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_article_tag kat2 INNER JOIN knowledge_tag kt2 ON kt2.id = kat2.tag_id AND kt2.deleted = 0 WHERE kat2.article_id = a.id AND kat2.deleted = 0 AND kt2.name = #{tag} ) AND a.status = #{status} AND a.author_id = #{authorId} GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.category_id, a.source_ticket_id, a.status, a.author_id, a.view_count, a.published_time, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_by, a.update_by, a.deleted, c.name, u.username, t.ticket_no
ORDER BY a.view_count DESC, a.id DESC ORDER BY a.published_time DESC, a.id DESC ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_article (id, title, summary, content, category_id, source_ticket_id, status, author_id, view_count, published_time, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{sourceTicketId}, #{status}, #{authorId}, #{viewCount}, #{publishedTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_article SET title=#{title}, summary=#{summary}, content=#{content}, category_id=#{categoryId}, source_ticket_id=#{sourceTicketId}, status=#{status}, published_time=#{publishedTime}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0

UPDATE knowledge_article SET status=#{status}, published_time=COALESCE(published_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)published_time, update_by=#{operatorId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_article SET deleted=1, update_by=#{operatorId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_article SET view_count=view_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM knowledge_article WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND deleted=0
SELECT tag_id FROM knowledge_article_tag WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_article_tag SET deleted=1, update_by=#{operatorId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_article_tag (id, article_id, tag_id, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{articleId}, #{tagId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, 0)
